title: coleus goetzenii
intro: Coleus goetzenii, commonly known as Wild Coleus, is a plant species in the Lamiaceae family, native to India and Southeast Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and protect against infections. The therapeutic actions of Coleus goetzenii include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce blood pressure, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
